Difficulties of Cut Methamphetamine
Methamphetamine cut with suspected n-iso (n-isopropylbenzylamine)
A bit of background: I am a scientist by trade, and very meticulous. I do an acid-base extraction on all methamphetamine to get rid of cuts. It does not remove n-iso (n-isopropylbenzylamine) as it is a stereoisomer.
I would guess it was cut 50% with n-iso (in the acid base extraction
I can see a clear layer (n-iso) forming over a cloudy layer (methamphetamine)
in the acid base extraction
I can see a clear layer (n-iso) forming over a cloudy layer (methamphetamine)

2215 164mg methamphetamine cut with ?n-iso (online vendor) in 0.5ml saline IV
Significant rush, tightness of throat, lasted less than 1-2 minutes, slightly underwhelming, yet I want to do it again???? How can that be addictive? HR shot up to 158, but came down to 90 on its own. I have some palpitations and arrhythmias when I lie in bed.
2230 100mg atenolol (beta blocker with no blood brain penetration) + 1.3g Magnesium threonate (magnesium with high CNS bioavailability) I feel wonderful. No side effects, tingling in body. Poor erections, very hard to get them, much much worse than methamphetamine on its own.
0156 50mg sildenafil
0230 erections are no problems now
0516 feeling tired. N-iso wearing off?
0630 I feel really tired and fatigued. I am making stupid mistakes. I watched porn/wanked all night. It is very difficult to contain, and to do something else. Unable to achieve orgasm after masturbating for an hour, much worse than methamphetamine experience
0715 1.6g piracetam. Made me feel better about an hour later, less tired
0900 chewing on lip, ulcer. Severe bruxism. Took another 1.3g Magnesium threonate
1100 50mg sildenafil
1300 45mg methamphetamine insufflated
1400 2g N-acetylcysteine (great for when coming down from stimulants)
Still cant cum
1700 HR 98. Atenolol 50mg, diazepam 10mg
1730 bad flatulence, feel cold and ill (probably flatulence induced). Feel very uncomfortable.
Metallic taste after diazepam. Difficulty in accommodating eyes.
HR 88
2000 felt really, tired, could probably sleep
2100 slept well
Whole trip I felt off. Disjointed, poor memory, false sense of time.
Notes:
 Methamphetamine/iso throws up a lot of red herrings. It makes it very easy to use sex as a tool of avoidance. I did not want to meditate because I was thinking about sex. Annoying!
 With methamphetamine/iso I can access my inner child and play with little daughter unencumbered. It was so easy to play with her, so natural.
 Ice/iso does not cause increased sex drive, but it can power avoidance defences like libido.
 Second dose of sildenafil was not useful at all for erections probably made it worse (do not go above 50mg per day)
Take home messages:
1. 160mg IV methamphetamine/iso is TOO MUCH. Horrible side effect profile (like hours of porn with a shrivelled penis).
2. Do not use more than 50mg sildenalfil as it causes decrease in errection quality
ADDIT:
Following days very low mood, irritability and an intense craving for methamphetamine which I never get when I use methamphetamine alone. N-ISO causes depression, anxiety and cravings.
Tips to tell your methamphetamine is cut with n-iso:
1.	Crystals are softer
2.	When smoking it smells burnt and leaves more of a brown/black residue.
3.	When doing an acid/base extraction, n-iso will form a clear layer over a cloudy layer of methamphetamine
4.	N-iso causes autonomic instability. Heart rate will increase dramatically (160 for no reason), then drop back down. Its quite empathic at the start (for a couple of hours), but the second peak makes me feel like I am in a delirium. It effects sexually function n dramatically, and will make erections impossible for hours.
5.	If
I can sleep after iv methamphetamine, then it has n-iso (not a bad thing in itself)
6.	Horrible depression/irritability and cravings for the following week. Really not worth it at all.
How to purify methamphetamine with Acid/Base extraction:
Methamphetamine is an alkaloid, which means that it is water soluble in acid solutions and lipid soluble in basic solutions.
Assuming
1g of street methamphetamine:
1.	Dissolve in water in a small glass (shot glass will do)
2.	Add a couple of milliliters of concentrated sodium hydroxide solution until cloudy, then add some more to be sure (buy drain unblocker from hardware store for sodium hydroxide, just make it sure it only contain sodium hydroxide and no metal fillings as well)
3.	Check for n-iso (clear layer over a cloudy layer may need to wait 15-30min flor layers to separate)
4.	Add non-polar solvent (5ml) (eg heptane, but also can use shellite from Bunnings)
5.	Shake like hell for 2min (put cling film over top)
6.	Use eye droper or the like and remove shellite (contains methamphetamine)
7.	Repeat non-polar wash 2 more times
8.	Add 5ml 1M HCl (you can buy muriatic acid from Bunnings, which is 320g/L HCl, which is 8.8M. So dilute 1:8.8 or add 57ml acid to 443ml water (never add water to acid, it splatters and will burn you)). Shake vigorously for 2 min. Wait until layer separate (5min). Tapping the solution may help in separating. Pipette out the water layer (bottom layer which contain methamphetamine. Repeat this 2 more times. Discard non-polar (shellite) layer after three washes with acid water.
9.	Evaporate acid water containing methamphetamine. DO NOT USE AS IS. Too much acid in in there, and wreck your teeth/veins. When the water evaporates, so does the acid. You can leave it at room temperature for a week or two, or put it into a food dehydrator overnight at 50C.
10.	If the crystals are yellow, it means there is still too much acid in there. It can crust up at the top, and leave acid trapped underneath. You can break it up, or also add 5ml isopropyl alcohol (do not use denatured ethanol (methylated spirits)! The denatured part will make remain and make the methamphetamine really bitter and unpleasant). This will make the acid water evaporate more quickly.
11.	The crystals will small and white if dried rapidly and using a dehydrator. That is fine, it works perfectly well. If still slightly yellow, put in a zip-lock with a small dessicant sachet).
12.	If you want nice crystals, best ones by dissolving in small amount of water and letting evaporate over days at room temp. If more in a hurry, dissolve in isopropyl alcohol and let evaporate slowly at room temperature over a day or so. Dont stir or agitate obviously.
Done!
